t: L4 Westmead & Carlingford Line running at reduced frequency
x:
Light Rail services are running at a reduced frequency due to light rail vehicle repairs.
Allow extra travel time and check information displays at stops for service updates.

From Monday 2 November until Sunday 8 November, the lift between the station footbridge and Warwick Street will be closed for lift maintenance.

Lift access to the station will be available on the opposite side of the station on Remembrance Avenue.

If you need further assistance, ask station staff…

Buses are diverting away from part of Norwest Boulevard due to a car fire.

• The buses are using Solent Circuit instead.

• Three stops are being missed. (2153481, 2153482, 2153477).

Allow extra travel time due to a person on the tracks at St Leonards. Stops and platforms may change at short notice, please listen for announcements and check information screen before joining your train.

You may also consider catching Metro or other nearby public transport services to continue your journey while the incident is ongoing.

Metro or other nearby public transport services may be an option for you until on time running is restored. Please use transport apps to plan your trip.
